note: App content: documentation of how the EU VAT scenarios are expressed with the determination keys (07, 8.4, with the derived keys origin_eu and destination_eu of ADR-200), tax code attributes (08, 6.2) and the EN 16931 pairing (STD_EN16931). It is the catalogue of 08, section 3 made reusable across country packages. Indicative: every row must be verified per member state in its country package (P15). The `domestic_first` rule: DK to DK style domestic rules carry a lower priority value than the EU rules, because the EU flags are true for the company's own country too (07, 8.4, 08, 3.1)

scenarios.name: Domestic reverse charge
scenarios.return: Boxes of both sides (line_side PRIMARY and COUNTER)

en16931.note: A country may use category O (outside scope), per country package

scenarios.name: Acquisition of services from another EU country

scenarios.return: OSS rows by consumption country, rate and supply kind

scenarios.name: Import from outside the EU, VAT paid at customs
scenarios.return: STANDARD boxes. Customs data is not in the finance core (08, Q7)

scenarios.name: Import with postponed accounting
scenarios.return: STANDARD boxes, both sides. Some countries (DK, UNVERIFIED) report all imports this way
